module_summary: AXI-Lite write-channel register slice: independent AW, W and B channels each use a single-entry register (selected by REG_TYPE parameters) with registered ready to break timing paths.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axil_awaddr_reg
anchors.why: AW channel register capturing write address and driving master awaddr.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Registered AW valid toward master side.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Registered AW ready to slave side, high when AW register will be empty.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave AW valid loaded into AW valid register.

anchors.name: m_axil_awready
anchors.why: Master AW ready clearing the AW valid register.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axil_aw_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing slave AW address/prot into AW register.

anchors.name: genblk2.m_axil_wdata_reg
anchors.why: W channel register capturing write data/strobe toward master.

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Registered W valid toward master side.

anchors.name: s_axil_wready
anchors.why: Registered W ready to slave, high when W register will be empty.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave W valid loaded into W valid register.

anchors.name: m_axil_wready
anchors.why: Master W ready clearing the W valid register.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axil_w_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing slave wdata/wstrb into W register.

anchors.name: genblk3.s_axil_bresp_reg
anchors.why: B channel register holding write response returned to slave side.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Registered write response valid toward slave side.

anchors.name: m_axil_bready
anchors.why: Registered B ready to master, high when B register will be empty.

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Master response valid loaded into B valid register.

anchors.name: s_axil_bready
anchors.why: Slave response ready clearing B valid register.

anchors.name: genblk3.store_axil_b_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing master bresp into B register.

groups.name: AW register stage
groups.description: Single-entry write-address register with registered ready.

groups.name: W register stage
groups.description: Single-entry write-data register with registered ready.

groups.name: B register stage
groups.description: Single-entry write-response register returning bresp to slave side.
